package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type StudentPracticeTaskRepository interface {
	CreateStudentPracticeTask(ctx context.Context, project domain.StudentPracticeTask, milestones []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone) error
	GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx context.Context, studentPracticeTaskID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTask, error)
	GetStudentPracticeTaskByWorkspaceTaskID(ctx context.Context, workspaceTaskID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTask, error)
	GetStudentPracticeTaskByWorkspaceLessonID(ctx context.Context, workspaceLessonID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTask, error)
	ListStudentPracticeTasks(ctx context.Context, studentID string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTask, error)
	CountStudentPracticeTasksByPracticeTaskID(ctx context.Context, practiceTaskID string) (int, error)
	CountStudentPracticeTasksByPartID(ctx context.Context, practiceTaskPartID string) (int, error)
	CountStudentPracticeTasksByMilestoneID(ctx context.Context, practiceTaskMilestoneID string) (int, error)
	UpdateStudentPracticeTask(ctx context.Context, project domain.StudentPracticeTask) error
	ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx context.Context, studentPracticeTaskID string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, error)
	UpdateStudentPracticeTaskMilestone(ctx context.Context, milestone domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone) error
	CreateArtifact(ctx context.Context, artifact domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact) error
	ListArtifacts(ctx context.Context, studentPracticeTaskID string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskArtifact, error)
	CreateFinalReview(ctx context.Context, review domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error)
	UpdateFinalReview(ctx context.Context, review domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview) error
	GetFinalReview(ctx context.Context, reviewID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error)
	ListFinalReviews(ctx context.Context, studentPracticeTaskID string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error)
	ListPendingFinalReviews(ctx context.Context, limit, offset int) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskFinalReview, error)
	SaveTaskBinding(ctx context.Context, binding domain.StudentPracticeTaskTaskBinding) error
	GetTaskBindingByAnswerID(ctx context.Context, answerID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTaskTaskBinding, error)
}
